Here is the step-by-step reasoning for each problem:

**[id 30]**
Darrell and Allen's ages are in the ratio 7:11. Let Darrell's age be $7x$ and Allen's age be $11x$.
$7x + 11x = 162 \Rightarrow 18x = 162 \Rightarrow x = 9$.
Allen's current age is $11 \times 9 = 99$.
10 years from now, Allen will be $99 + 10 = 109$.

**[id 31]**
First guess = $80$
Second guess = $(80 / 2) + 20 = 40 + 20 = 60$
Third guess = $80 + (0.25 \times 80) = 80 + 20 = 100$
Average guess = $(80 + 60 + 100) / 3 = 240 / 3 = 80$

**[id 32]**
Hours spent per day on $10$ dogs = $10 \times 0.5 = 5$ hours.
Hours spent per week = $5 \times 7 = 35$ hours.

**[id 33]**
Let $s$ be silver coins and $g$ be gold coins.
$g = s + 30$
$s + g = 110 \Rightarrow s + (s + 30) = 110 \Rightarrow 2s = 80 \Rightarrow s = 40$.
Gold coins = $40 + 30 = 70$.

**[id 34]**
Raymond has $40$ jewels.
Aaron has $(40 / 2) + 5 = 20 + 5 = 25$ jewels.
Siobhan has $25 - 2 = 23$ jewels.

**[id 35]**
Points in the first 20 minutes = $4$.
Points in the second 20 minutes = $4 + (0.25 \times 4) = 4 + 1 = 5$.
Total points = $4 + 5 = 9$.

**[id 36]**
Total yogurts Terry eats over 30 days = $30 \times 2 = 60$ yogurts.
Since 4 yogurts cost $\$5.00$, he needs $60 / 4 = 15$ bundles.
Total spent = $15 \times \$5.00 = \$75$.

**[id 37]**
John spent $8 \times \$20 = \$160$ on video games and had $\$5$ left over, meaning he made $\$165$ from selling lego sets.
Number of lego sets sold = $\$165 / \$15 = 11$ sets.
He started with $13$, so he has $13 - 11 = 2$ left.

**[id 38]**
Time spent running on the first day = $3$ hours.
Time spent running on the other two days = $1.5$ hours each (since it's half of the first day).
Total time = $3 + 1.5 + 1.5 = 6$ hours.
Speed = Distance / Time = $60$ miles / $6$ hours = $10$ mph.

**[id 39]**
Skip speed = $3$ mph.
Since her skip speed is half her run speed, her run speed is $3 \times 2 = 6$ mph.
Since her run speed is $4$ times her walk speed, her walk speed is $6 / 4 = 1.5$ mph.
Time running = $1/3$ of 6 hours = $2$ hours.
Time walking = $2/3$ of 6 hours = $4$ hours.
Distance running = $2$ hours $\times 6$ mph = $12$ miles.
Distance walking = $4$ hours $\times 1.5$ mph = $6$ miles.
Total distance = $12 + 6 = 18$ miles.
